records.claim: Taking methotrexate in the first trimester could increase the chance of a specific pattern of birth defects of the head, face, limbs, and bones. It is not clear if methotrexate could cause other kinds of birth defects. Heart defects and oral clefts (cleft lip and/or cleft palate) have been reported in some infants exposed to methotrexate during pregnancy; however, there is not enough information to know if methotrexate could have caused these birth defects.
records.source_section: Does taking methotrexate increase the chance of birth defects?
